title: Nicholas Throckmorton to Elizabeth I, Paris, 10 July 1559, in his Cipher 1: BL Add MS 4136 f. 32 (DECODE R2988)

steps.what: Tomokiyo unsolved.htm and project throckmorton notes: f. 32 carries Throckmorton's own letter of 10 July 1559 in his Cipher 1, for which Tomokiyo gives the key; no printed decipherment.
Subagent decryption of R2988 main text with Tomokiyo Cipher 1 key; crops misaligned, lines 1-5 only.
Main text re-cut at measured line centres; lines 1-4 read securely, lines 5-15 decode to English with key corrections (x,υ=i; z=m; ∫t=w; Q=be).

Pass 3 over lines 5-15 (main_decrypt.txt): flat-topped 6 = w, q = u, zeta = null inside words, dotted q = your Majesty, K = all(?); lines 5-15 read at about 85% (about 470 of 550 signs); twelve code signs open.
CSP Foreign vol. 1 pp. 362-369 (BHO) and Forbes I: only the 8 July 1559 despatches are calendared; no text of the 10 July letter.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from wod1568, which had joined three systems on BL Add MS 4136 ff. 32-33: Throckmorton's Cipher 1 letter of 10 July 1559 (throck1559), the f. 32 marginal word-sign code (throck1559margin) and John Wood's 1568 line (wod1568). This profile keeps Throckmorton's 10 July 1559 letter in Cipher 1 (R2988 main text) only.

outcome.method_basis: Throckmorton's 10 July 1559 letter was deciphered with Tomokiyo's Cipher 1 key image for Throckmorton's correspondence, with seven values corrected; lines 1-4 secure, lines 5-15 about 85%.
outcome.fraction_read_source: NOTES pass 3: lines 1-4 secure and lines 5-15 about 470 of 550 signs (85%); not counted sign by sign from a reading file.
outcome.notes: Unpublished letter: Throckmorton sends a gentleman to report the French King's state, asks credit and reward for him, signs off at Paris the tenth of July. Twelve code signs open. The starred note keyed to line 13 is in the margin word code (throck1559margin). Split 14 Oct 2026 from wod1568.
